Ghostty snapshot codec fixtures, copied verbatim from `src/terminal/snapshot/testdata/` at
`83fb95624b0439ee660c2679b43b38c8b63769cd` (MIT, Copyright Mitchell Hashimoto and contributors).
`old-pin-complete-v1.hex` is `complete-v1.hex` from the preceding ngterm pin,
`81598385d608dda4946093d6d6a234d204a2f225`, to verify image-free decoding compatibility.
These are codec records, independent of the renderer sprite goldens.
